name: Fisheye Distortion Correction
definition: Corrects the visual distortion where a flat wall appears bowed or curved (fisheye effect) because rays fired at angles have longer Euclidean lengths than the ray fired straight ahead.
summary: Fisheye Distortion Correction replaces naive Euclidean ray lengths with perpendicular distances to ensure flat walls render as straight lines, unlike methods that merely define viewing geometry.
